commit.subject: conductor: complete portable dispatch wrapper
commit.body:
Preserve repeated input paths in order, pass the launcher's timeout wire, and refuse stale timeout configuration before launch. Resolve the launcher from the invoking environment, configuration, or the current worktree's sibling and expose that provenance.

Add detached dispatch with a minted-record handshake and durable launcher log, pass it through go.sh, and teach the permission doctor the sibling fallback. Keep launcher runtime custody outside the repository lint floor.

Verified: `python3 -m unittest discover -s ops/conductor/tests -p 'test_[!l]*.py' && python3 -m unittest discover -s ops/devlane/hooks/tests && python3 -m unittest discover -s ops/devlane/telemetry/tests && ruff check ..` at the final tree based on 54ecabd668bb0aff9a08f28d62d00f609034c536 — 234 conductor, 159 hook, and 208 telemetry tests OK; Ruff passed.
